We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have already applied template 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (list). Need to choose one that can be further processed with next template 1914389, then 1914390, then 149040, then 1914391.

We need to construct a tree JSON where each reaction node has children precursors (mol nodes). For each step, we need to apply template to each precursor? Typically retrosynthesis: each reaction splits target into precursors; then each precursor may be further broken down by next template.

We need at least 5 reactions total, so chain of 5 steps (linear) is acceptable. Use templates sequentially.

Thus we need to find a linear path: target -> apply 29646 -> get precursor A (choose one) -> apply 1914389 to A -> get precursor B -> apply 1914390 to B -> get precursor C -> apply 149040 to C -> get precursor D -> apply 1914391 to D -> get final precursors (starting materials). Ensure each template matches.

We have to test matches and apply.

We have already applied 29646 to target, got three precursors:

Result from apply_template: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO',))"

So three possible precursors. The second one lacks silyl groups; third has silyl on O. The first has silyl on both O? Actually first has CO[Si] and also O[Si] maybe.

We need a precursor that matches template 1914389. We tested earlier: first precursor matched True, second and third? We checked first with 1914389 True. Then we applied 1914389 to first and got two products: ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC').

So applying 1914389 to first precursor gave two possible outcomes (two sets of precursors). The first product is a molecule with silyl still attached; second is a separate molecule (maybe a side product). For retrosynthesis, we need to consider the main product (the one that continues). Likely the first is the main fragment that will be further transformed.

Thus after step 2, we have precursor1 = "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C". We'll attempt to apply template 1914390 to this.

We earlier checked matching: it returned False. So maybe need to choose a different precursor from step 2 that matches 1914390.

The second product from step2 is "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". Does that match 1914390? We checked earlier and got False.

Thus maybe we need to choose a different branch from step1 (second or third precursor) that matches 1914389 then 1914390.

We tested second precursor "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO" with 1914389: got False. Third precursor "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO" matched True for 1914389. Let's test applying 1914389 to third precursor.
